invariant: Area review completion never authorizes Runtime Adoption, production, deployment, or SEAL. Those remain independent governance gates.

areas.title: Core product promise and epistemic boundaries
areas.review_focus: Review the five epistemic layers, absolute integrity invariants, and the rule that lower layers cannot rewrite higher layers.

areas.title: Look Back, Look Today, Tomorrow Check, Look Future and Quiet Sky
areas.review_focus: Review product time model and distinguish a valid no-signal observation from technical failure.

areas.title: Today's Note and Quiet Sky
areas.review_focus: Locate an already-approved product/UI/copy decision before proposing behavior.

areas.title: Product voice, tone and consumer experience
areas.review_focus: Reconcile source-backed claim limits with any owner-approved non-fatalistic/quiet language rules.

areas.title: Canon Rule Registry and allowed semantic coverage
areas.review_focus: Verify whether approved populated current V1 rules exist, their lineage, and manifest binding; preserve fail-closed behavior.

areas.title: Historical three-AI architecture versus current V1
areas.review_focus: Keep historic V8 orchestration separate from current V1 language architecture unless controlled scope change is decided.

areas.title: Voice Boundary and negative-sounding language
areas.review_focus: Find approved V1 voice disposition; distinguish honest limitations from unnecessary fear, fatalism, or demeaning language.

areas.title: Feedback, mismatch, and anti-confirmation safeguards
areas.review_focus: Preserve session-scoped categorical feedback, no narrative rescue, and no feedback-to-accuracy conversion.

areas.title: Deep Sky product and fulfillment contract
areas.review_focus: Verify Deep Sky entitlement, constrained synthesis, validation, delivery, reread, and failure contracts.

areas.title: Credits, ownership, entitlement and idempotency
areas.review_focus: Reconcile balance ownership, non-expiry, reading entitlement, duplicate prevention, deletion and remedies.

areas.title: One new Deep Sky purchase per CE service day
areas.review_focus: Preserve owner-originated purchase cap and owner-approved UTC boundary; resolve trigger, failure, concurrency and remedy mechanics from sources before recommendation.

areas.title: Paid-market readiness and payment/legal boundaries
areas.review_focus: Separate internal US research baseline from market-specific launch approval and unresolved payment/consumer issues.

areas.title: Account identity, trusted devices and recovery
areas.review_focus: Verify account ownership, device security, recovery, birth-data versioning and deletion boundaries.

areas.title: Personal Context and data-minimization boundary
areas.review_focus: Preserve persistent Personal Context/free-text exclusion from V1 AI input unless a controlled change reopens it.

areas.title: Share Card retirement from V1
areas.review_focus: Preserve current V1 removal and historical artifacts; do not reopen as an active feature decision.

areas.title: Locale, currency and market assumptions
areas.review_focus: Verify prior owner decisions; do not infer English-only, en-US-only, USD-only or US-first from examples.

areas.title: Normative stack, source lineage and document metadata
areas.review_focus: Verify exact source identity, hierarchy, supersession and bounded metadata discrepancies.

areas.title: Autonomous operating mandate and delegated authority
areas.review_focus: Reconcile mandate with current governance; distinguish autonomous work from policy/authority transitions.

areas.title: Independent testing, expected-value oracle and release controls
areas.review_focus: Check candidate identity, oracle validity, CI enforcement, independent verification and rollback.

areas.title: A9/A10 and current runtime authority state
areas.review_focus: Keep A9 and A10 scopes separate; do not treat Trusted Build as Runtime Adoption or production authorization.

areas.title: Other previously discussed areas discovered during review
areas.review_focus: Add any prior-discussion topic uncovered by source search; do not treat this list as permission to omit unlisted areas.
